_meta.description: Per-file provenance vs HestiaCP. A file with no upstream_path is HestiaRE-native. Recompute is a manual, occasional job (when we reimplement against upstream or re-measure a snapshot); numbers are a snapshot at each file's upstream_ref + measured_at, not live. HestiaRE does not cherry-pick: every adoption is a reimplementation, compared per function against the upstream diff, so these numbers are orientation for that comparison - not a merge plan.
_meta.divergence_method: churn = (added+removed)/(upstream_lines+our_lines)*100 from `git diff --numstat`. RAW - overstates semantic divergence. Triage, not truth. BINARY files are measured by byte identity instead (pct 0 or 100, method "bytes"): a line diff on a binary reports nothing at all - git numstat prints "-" - which silently read as 0% churn and typed a differing font or image as verbatim.

source_type_values.verbatim: Upstream file we track closely (churn <=3%). Mechanical: reseeded from the measured pct on every recompute, never set by hand.
source_type_values.derived: Reimplemented or diverged from upstream on purpose (churn >3%). Mechanical: reseeded from the measured pct on every recompute, never set by hand.
source_type_values.eigenbau: HestiaRE-native: no upstream counterpart. The one curated value - a recompute never changes it. An 'inspired by' pointer belongs in the note, not in upstream_path.

_meta.third_party_note: Third-party vendored code is tracked in VENDORED.json, not here; those paths are excluded to keep the two manifests disjoint.
_meta.reorg_note: #119 dissolved upstream install/deb/ into share/; paths do not line up 1:1. Matches are exact-path first, then unique basename; unmatched files are marked eigenbau with a note and need manual origin confirmation. Best-effort, not authoritative.

aggregate.weighted_pct_note: text files only - binary entries are byte-compared, not line-counted

_meta.recompute_rule: Reseed before every minor release: recompute against the current upstream/hestiacp snapshot and let source_type follow the fresh pct. verbatim/derived is a bucketing of the measured number, so it goes stale exactly when the number does - it drifted 80 entries out of step once (#551). eigenbau is the one curated value and a recompute never touches it. Byte-compared entries carry no pct at all - there is no percentage to have: the reseed reads their `identical` flag, text entries their pct.
